original.statement: Helm value enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and is a no-op in 1.16.

decision.reason: [ev-99f86df45975] says the Helm option `enableRuntimeDeviceDetection` is now deprecated and does nothing (a no-op), and names no replacement. So only environments that set this value explicitly are affected, which is what values-key{enableRuntimeDeviceDetection, set} captures. The computed default change (false → true) between [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and [ev-39a22d88e2f5] does not widen exposure, because a no-op key's default has no effect on environments that leave it unset.
